data.name: Spirit Totem
data.description: While raging, the spirits that surround the barbarian make it difficult for her enemies to see her. The spirits grant the barbarian a 20%% miss chance against ranged attacks and melee attacks made by creatures that are not adjacent to the barbarian (typically due to reach).
